text:
alert-bot: ALERT - High-rate DB activity detected in prod-us-east
alert-bot: 1200 SELECTs/min from service account `maintenance-sa` against `exports.*` tables
maria: @jordan can you confirm whether we rolled out any RBAC changes this morning? :eyes:
jordan: yes there was a permissions deploy at 2026-03-02T09:10Z that added read on `exports.*` to maintenance-sa, part of scheduled data-sync job
lee: checking audit logs now, querying:
```
SELECT * FROM audit_events WHERE resource LIKE 'exports.%' AND ts > '2026-03-02' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 100;
```
lee: I see a flurry of GRANTs at 09:09 UTC from infra-ci user, then the selects start at 09:11
maria: can we contain? revoke the grant and rotate keys for maintenance-sa
jordan: revoking now: `REVOKE SELECT ON exports.* FROM maintenance-sa;` and rotated service principal token. :white_check_mark:
jordan: also blocked the runner role on prod for now, added a temporary deny policy
pagerbot: Pager duty incident INC-9275 created by maria (sev 2)
sara: we need to assess data exposure and notify legal/privacy if exports contain PII. @maria please collect sample query results and affected rows estimate
lee: quick audit: ~18k rows accessed, no S3 egress events, but KMS decrypts spike around same time
maria: good that no S3 egress. jordan can you pull KMS CloudTrail logs for decrypt calls and principals
jordan: KMS shows decrypts by role `batch-runner` which appears to assume maintenance-sa via sts:AssumeRole - possible chained escalation
maria: capture STS logs and open a vuln triage ticket. Action items: 1) Revert RBAC rollouts to gating, 2) Add canary and rate limits for service accounts, 3) Require approval for grants to exports tables, 4) Postmortem in #postmortems
sara: I'll draft customer/exec comms if needed; for now classify as contained - PII unknown until deep audit
maria: making follow-up issues and assigning. Monitoring alerts lowered to watch. Thanks all :pray:
jordan: creating PR to add automated rollback on permission anomalies
lee: uploading audit snippets to the incident doc
maria: closing thread for containment. Will reopen if we see repeats. :lock:
